chat.author: abhi shelat
chat.text: ligero -> polygero is not for run-time performance. it is also for additional bits of security.  See eprint/2026/2481 for how/why it can achieve 127 bits of security. (of course for full 127, all parts of the system need to get there)

chat.author: Muhammad Usama Sardar

chat.author: Emil Lundberg
chat.text:
Muhammad Usama Sardar said:

Thanks, but you do not do remote attestation, right?

"attestation" in this contest typically refers to "electronic attestation of attributes" which is the term used in the legal text to describe verifiable digital credentials

chat.author: Muhammad Usama Sardar
chat.text: Thanks, Emil. So it has nothing to do with remote attestation of RFC9334, right?
